verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Muse operates with a VM/file system where users can place files and Muse can inspect/edit/download them (muse-supp-vm-files-export), but there is no evidence describing document upload, spreadsheet parsing, PDF ingestion, or any claim of 'accurate analysis' of such content types. Missing for 10: explicit document/PDF/spreadsheet upload workflow, evidence of extraction or comprehension accuracy, and any user testimonial or benchmark showing correct analysis of uploaded files.
